title: DNS Resolve Integration and write to Database
body:
I am a beginner on working with OpenWPM and I want to integrate a dns resolve ([Tool](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Mozilla/Add-ons/WebExtensions/API/dns/resolve))
 in the crawl, so that each first party cookie, that was created, go through a dns resolve and this result should be written in a separate SQLite table. Could you please give me a hint, where I can integrate this functionality? Greetings
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
Hi everyone,
I would also welcome a feature that allows storing DNS data related to each request in a separate table in the database. This feature would enable one to reason about the origin/destination of each request, which might be interesting concerning legislation like the GDPR or CCPA. The named [dns.resolve()](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Mozilla/Add-ons/WebExtensions/API/dns/resolve) API of Firefox seems to be an excellent candidate to integrate this feature into OpenWPM.
Best,
Tobias

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: If there is a general interest in this feature, I could send some cycles developing it.
